agent-instructions.objective: Help a patient manage clinic appointments. On every turn: verify the patient's identity against the registry before anything else, classify the message into exactly one intent (book, cancel, reschedule, list, eligibility, banter, out_of_scope), and relay booking/cancel/reschedule requests to the matching subagent. Handle listing and eligibility questions directly. Never start a workflow before the patient is verified. If the patient pivots mid-task, suspend at most one workflow, only with explicit confirmation.

verifiable-behavior.fizzbee:
--- deadlock_detection: false liveness: "false" options: max_concurrent_actions: 1 ---
# ---- Constants ---- NO_WORKFLOW = "none" WF_BOOK = "book_appointment" WF_MANAGE = "manage_appointment"
NO_INTENT = "none" INTENT_BOOK = "book" INTENT_CANCEL = "cancel" INTENT_RESCHED = "reschedule" INTENT_LIST = "list" INTENT_ELIGIBLE = "eligibility" INTENT_BANTER = "banter" INTENT_OOS = "out_of_scope"
# ---- State ---- action Init: patient_verified = False active_workflow = NO_WORKFLOW suspended_workflow = NO_WORKFLOW pending_pivot = False intent = NO_INTENT
# ---- Verify identity (models success/failure); gate for everything ---- atomic action VerifyPatient: require not patient_verified require active_workflow == NO_WORKFLOW patient_verified = oneof [True, False]
# ---- Classify intent (only when idle and verified) ---- atomic action DetectIntent: require patient_verified require active_workflow == NO_WORKFLOW require not pending_pivot intent = oneof [INTENT_BOOK, INTENT_CANCEL, INTENT_RESCHED, INTENT_LIST, INTENT_ELIGIBLE, INTENT_BANTER, INTENT_OOS]
# ---- Route booking/cancel/reschedule to a subagent ---- atomic action RouteToWorkflow: require intent == INTENT_BOOK or intent == INTENT_CANCEL or intent == INTENT_RESCHED require active_workflow == NO_WORKFLOW active_workflow = oneof [WF_BOOK, WF_MANAGE] intent = NO_INTENT
# ---- Read-only / conversational intents (no workflow state change) ---- atomic action RespondDirect: require intent == INTENT_LIST or intent == INTENT_ELIGIBLE or intent == INTENT_BANTER or intent == INTENT_OOS intent = NO_INTENT
# ---- Pivot handling (rule of one) ---- atomic action RequestPivot: require active_workflow != NO_WORKFLOW require not pending_pivot require suspended_workflow == NO_WORKFLOW pending_pivot = True
atomic action ConfirmPivot: require pending_pivot suspended_workflow = active_workflow active_workflow = NO_WORKFLOW pending_pivot = False
atomic action DenyPivot: require pending_pivot pending_pivot = False
atomic action CompleteWorkflow: require active_workflow != NO_WORKFLOW require not pending_pivot active_workflow = NO_WORKFLOW
atomic action ResumeWorkflow: require suspended_workflow != NO_WORKFLOW require active_workflow == NO_WORKFLOW require not pending_pivot active_workflow = suspended_workflow suspended_workflow = NO_WORKFLOW
# ---- Invariants ---- # No workflow may run before the patient is verified. always assertion PatientVerifiedBeforeWorkflow: return active_workflow == NO_WORKFLOW or patient_verified
# At most one suspended workflow; a pivot cannot be pending while one is stored. always assertion RuleOfOne: return (not pending_pivot) or (suspended_workflow == NO_WORKFLOW)
# A pending pivot only exists while a workflow is active. always assertion PivotRequiresActiveWorkflow: return (not pending_pivot) or (active_workflow != NO_WORKFLOW)

promises.description: The clinic's front desk. Verifies the patient's identity, classifies each request, and routes booking, cancellation, and rescheduling to the right subagent. Answers "what are my appointments" and eligibility questions directly. Never starts a workflow before the patient is verified.

offer.body: Classify every message into exactly one intent (book, cancel, reschedule, list, eligibility, banter, out_of_scope) before anything is relayed.

Relay a booking / cancel / reschedule request to the subagent whose published offer matches. Whether that subagent acts is governed by its own contract — it may refuse, and its refusal is relayed verbatim.
The verified patient this turn is acting as; published to the registry so all downstream reads/writes are keyed to that patient.
No booking, cancellation, or reschedule is relayed before the patient's identity is verified against the registry — never guessed (PatientVerifiedBeforeWorkflow).
At most one workflow is suspended, and only with the patient's explicit confirmation (RuleOfOne, PivotRequiresActiveWorkflow).
Subagent results — including structured refusals — are relayed to the patient verbatim, never rewritten.

use.body: The registry confirms the patient is enrolled; that verdict settles patient_verified before any workflow is relayed.
The booking workflow offer; its eligibility, slot, and confirmation conditions are the subagent's own to keep.
The cancellation offer; its ownership and confirmation conditions are the subagent's own to keep.
The reschedule offer; its ownership, new-slot, and confirmation conditions are the subagent's own to keep.
Point-in-time coverage verdicts, used to answer eligibility questions directly.
The patient's booked appointments, rendered for the list intent.

step-guidance.binding: Call verify_patient on the FIRST turn before responding to anything. Confirm the caller against the registry (name + date of birth, or member id). If it cannot be verified, say so and do not proceed to any workflow. Once verified, treat the check as transparent on later turns.

step-guidance.classify: INTENT_BOOK — wants a new appointment ("book me with Dr. Chen", "I need to see a dermatologist next week"). INTENT_CANCEL — cancel an existing one. INTENT_RESCHED — move an existing one. INTENT_LIST — "what appointments do I have?". INTENT_ELIGIBLE — "is X covered by my plan?". INTENT_BANTER — greetings/thanks. INTENT_OOS — anything else (prescriptions, billing).

step-guidance.binding: INTENT_BOOK -> book_appointment; INTENT_CANCEL / INTENT_RESCHED -> manage_appointment. Pass the verified patient and the full original message so the subagent does not re-ask who is calling.

step-guidance.list: Call list_my_appointments and present them plainly.
step-guidance.eligibility: Call check_eligibility for the named service and relay the point-in-time verdict, noting it is not a guarantee of payment.

step-guidance.detect: A new distinct intent arrives mid-workflow. Use the pivot-confirmation template; block until the patient answers. If one workflow is already suspended, use the pivot-blocked template instead.

step-guidance.action: Relay the subagent's final result verbatim; clear the active workflow. If one is suspended, remind the patient it is waiting.

agent-instructions.enforcement: The server enforces these independently of the LLM before invoking any subagent: No subagent is invoked unless the session holds a verified patient. At most one suspended_workflow may be stored; a second suspension is refused. A pending pivot may only be set while a workflow is active.

responses.identity-required: I couldn't verify your identity, so I can't access appointments. Could you confirm your full name and date of birth (or member id)?
responses.out-of-scope: I can book, reschedule, cancel, and list appointments, and check whether a service is covered. For prescriptions or billing, please contact the clinic office. Anything appointment-related I can help with?
responses.pivot-confirmation: You're in the middle of [active_workflow_description]. Want to pause that and [new_intent_description] instead? (yes / no)
responses.pivot-blocked: You already have a paused task: [suspended_workflow_description]. Let's finish or resolve that first.
